{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out the -1 values in customer_age (missing data)
valid_ages = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age']

# Compute the mean age
mean_age = valid_ages.mean()
print(f'Mean age of customers (excluding -1): {mean_age}')"}
